title: NetPerfMeter dissector improvement
description:
The current version of the NetPerfMeter dissector does not properly handle long messages over multiple packet, as well as multiple short messages within one packet (example: [trace.pcap.gz](/uploads/8c533770f4419ec662b9340ce4c529a4/trace.pcap.gz)). This merge request fixes this issue:
* Handling NetPerfMeter message in multiple segments.
* Handling multiple NetPerfMeter messages in one segment.

notes.body: The issue is apparent for NetPerfMeter over TCP, as seen in the attached capture. I see that for this transport protocol the dissection fails due to lack of PDU boundaries, which the other transports (probably) provide. This is a known problem, which you best can tackled using `tcp_dissect_pdus()`, see doc/README.dissector section 2.7.1
